baseline_models.mechanism: QṢD holds intended orientation, straightness, and a mean between extremes together, while MŠY supplies enacted movement. The command therefore calibrates trajectory and manner, not speed alone.

activation_trace.role: Directed orientation supplies an intended destination; it makes the gait purposeful rather than merely slow.
Straight and even walking supplies a stable line; it makes bodily motion answer to a course.
A mean between extremes supplies proportionality; it prevents purpose from becoming excess or deficiency.
Voluntary walking supplies the concrete moving body; it is where intention and proportion become visible.

changed_reading.after: Set an intended, straight course and enact it between excesses; the imperative regulates trajectory as well as pace.

baseline_models.mechanism: The lowering branch of GḌḌ and the partitive construction make restraint subtractive: surplus is removed from an existing voice rather than voice being erased. The listening branch of ṢWT keeps a reciprocal auditory space live.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and lowering by reduction supplies graded subtraction; it makes restraint different from muteness.
Audible sound supplies the actual emission being calibrated; the command concerns how a voice enters shared space.
Attentive silence before sound supplies the receiving side; it makes reduced output a condition for mutual listening.

changed_reading.before: Speak quietly or suppress the voice.
changed_reading.after: Keep speaking, but subtract the excess that crowds out listening; the command regulates acoustic share rather than demanding silence.

baseline_models.mechanism: NKR permits simultaneous acoustic and relational readings: the worst sound is harsh and strange, but also one that resists recognition and is repelled. The donkey remains the concrete audible instance rather than being dissolved into abstraction.

activation_trace.role: Opposition to recognition and acknowledgment supplies alienness; it makes the superlative concern failed recognizability as well as ugliness.
A difficult, severe, strange thing supplies acoustic extremity; it keeps harshness within the reading.
Repelled ugliness supplies normative rejection; it makes manner capable of discrediting what the voice carries.
Heard sound supplies the sensory field in which strangeness, harshness, and rejection converge.
The known donkey supplies the literal terminal comparison; it anchors the broader NKR range in a concrete cry.

changed_reading.before: The donkey bray is simply the ugliest sound.
changed_reading.after: The donkey bray exemplifies sound at a threshold where harshness becomes alien and repellent; acoustic unpleasantness and failed recognition remain coexisting readings.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speech-hearing sequence separates loudness from uptake. Talk can seize attention and divert a course, while arrogance can produce non-hearing figured as weight in the ear. Lowering the voice thus refuses coercive amplification and protects speech from becoming another mechanism of diversion.

activation_trace.role: Reduction supplies the focus response to communicative resistance; it restrains force instead of escalating it.
Audible output supplies the channel whose force is being ethically calibrated.
Distraction by one thing from another supplies attention capture; it makes uncontrolled speech a rival to the intended path.
Renewed talk and report supplies voiced discourse; it identifies the material that can either communicate or divert.
Deviation from guidance and intent supplies the lost course; it links speech misuse to displacement from QṢD.
Pride and self-magnification supply the listener's refusal posture; they make non-hearing volitional rather than an amplitude problem.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies genuine uptake; it distinguishes reception from mere acoustic contact.
Weight in the ear supplies blocked reception; it shows why greater volume cannot by itself produce understanding.

structural_cues: 31:6 joins diverting talk to deviation from a path, and 31:7 follows with proud turning and performed non-hearing.
The focus then coordinates a course word with a voice-reduction command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attention-capturing talk, path loss, pride, and blocked understanding; I infer that voice reduction refuses to answer resistance with acoustic force. A live alternative is ordinary etiquette with no theory of persuasion.

changed_reading.before: Lowering the voice is generic politeness or volume control.
changed_reading.after: Lowering the voice is noncoercive communication: do not capture attention by force, and do not mistake amplitude for understanding or compliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to voice recognized good and restrain repudiated wrong is paired with self-restraint, then NKR reappears in the focus superlative. This activates a reflexive constraint: corrective speech must not become unrecognizable or reprehensible in its own delivery.

activation_trace.role: Request and obligation supply the voiced directive; they establish that speaking forcefully about conduct is sometimes required.
Good recognized by self, reason, and norm supplies the message's legible social form.
Rebuke and restraint supply the act of stopping wrong; they make correction an active speech setting.
Repelled ugliness supplies the wrong being restrained; its shared root lets rejected content reflect onto rejected vocal form.
Holding the self against panic supplies control of delivery under resistance.
Nonrecognition supplies the risk that correction can lose legibility through its manner.
Repelled ugliness supplies the reflexive test: a voice opposing wrong can itself take on a repellent form.
Audible voice supplies the medium whose form can preserve or betray the corrective message.

structural_cues: 31:17 places recognized good, repudiated wrong, and patience in one imperative chain two verses before the focus.
The same NKR root occurs in the object of prohibition and in the focus superlative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, recognized good, restraint of wrong, patience, and the NKR echo; I infer that delivery can invert a corrective message by becoming itself repellent. The live alternative is that the focus NKR is purely sonic and the echo is only lexical.

changed_reading.before: The donkey comparison warns against an independently ugly loud voice.
changed_reading.after: It also audits corrective speech: the voice used to oppose what is repudiated must not become repudiated in form, so patience governs delivery as well as endurance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah maps pride onto an averted cheek, exuberant gait, swagger, and boast. The focus answers through the same walking channel and adds voice reduction, forming one anti-inflation discipline across visible and audible presence.

activation_trace.role: Turning cheek and neck away in pride supplies visible social separation; it establishes the bodily field being corrected.
Walking supplies the repeated motor channel; it directly carries the prohibition into the focus command.
Joy exceeding its measure supplies bodily excess; it is the inflation that a middle gait reverses.
Swagger in one's walk supplies self-display encoded in locomotion; it sharpens QṢD as anti-performance.
Boasting and competitive display supply the audible-social extension of bodily pride.
The mean between extremes supplies the proportional countermeasure to self-expansion.
Voluntary gait supplies the same bodily channel now positively recalibrated.
Reduction supplies an acoustic counterpart to bodily deflation.
Audible sound supplies public presence beyond the body; lowering it blocks vocal self-enlargement.

structural_cues: 31:18-19 is a continuous cheek-gait-voice sequence, and MŠY repeats across the boundary.
Negative commands against proud display are followed by positive calibration of the same public body.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible pride, excessive gait, swagger, boasting, repeated walking, and lowered sound; I infer one cross-channel regulation of social amplitude. A live alternative treats gait and voice as separate manners listed together.

changed_reading.before: Walk humbly and speak softly as two decorous habits.
changed_reading.after: Reduce the body's and voice's bid to dominate shared space; moderation is coordinated de-inflation, not timid self-erasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tiny hidden item is still reached and inwardly known, and later divine hearing is explicit. These cues loosen the assumed link between acoustic force and efficacy: reduced speech can remain consequential, known, and heard.

activation_trace.role: Smallness, precision, and hiddenness supply efficacy below ordinary perceptual scale; they license a non-forceful mode of action.
Knowledge of inward reality supplies reliable awareness without outward magnitude.
Perception of sounds supplies hearing that does not need to be manufactured by vocal excess.
Lowering by reduction supplies the focus practice whose efficacy is being reconsidered.
Audible voice supplies the anchored domain; subtle efficacy changes how its necessary magnitude is imagined.

structural_cues: 31:16 moves from a minute hidden object to divine subtlety and inward knowledge.
31:28 closes a creation comparison with explicit hearing and sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies efficacy at hidden scale and complete hearing; I infer that faithful speech need not amplify itself to secure consequence or notice. The live alternative is that these divine predicates do not regulate human vocal manner.

changed_reading.before: A lower voice is merely socially pleasant but potentially less effective.
changed_reading.after: Reduced vocal force can be an enacted trust that consequence and audibility do not scale with display; subtle speech is not negligible speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence moves from intermingled turbulence through rescue and separation onto land, where QṢD reappears. That recurrence activates moderation as regained course after destabilization, not only a permanently calm temperament.

activation_trace.role: Intermingled wave motion supplies destabilizing turbulence; it creates the state from which a course must be recovered.
Rescue by separation supplies emergence from entanglement; it marks the transition toward restored orientation.
Dry land supplies a stable surface after the sea; it makes recovery spatially concrete.
The middle between extremes supplies the named post-rescue stance; it returns the focus root under changed conditions.
Straight and even walking supplies the focus's recoverable line of motion.
Enacted movement supplies the bodily anchor for carrying a restored course forward.

structural_cues: 31:32 orders wave, rescue, land, and a QṢD-derived stance in one temporal sequence.
The focus imperative and the later participle share QṢD but occur before and after radically different motion states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turbulence, separation, landfall, and QṢD recurrence; I infer a crisis-to-composure arrow that retrospectively dynamizes the walking command. A live alternative is that the later participle classifies belief or loyalty without bodily resonance.

changed_reading.before: Moderate walking expresses a settled personality and habitual pace.
changed_reading.after: It can also be practiced recovery: regain a straight middle course after turbulence and carry that restored orientation into ordinary movement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because severity and hardship are a distant same-root branch while the surface plainly denotes donkeys. It remains anchored in ḤMR, audible voice, and the command to reduce output; downstream prose should present strain as an exploratory overlay, never as a replacement for the animal comparison.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَصَوْتُ ٱلْحَمِيرِ after وَٱغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ

activation_trace.role: Severity and hardship supply a same-root image of strain; they activate exertive vocal force behind the comparison.
The literal donkey supplies the controlling lexical sense; it prevents the strain reading from floating free.
Audible cry supplies the sensory output in which strain can become socially abrasive.
Reduction supplies the remedy for surplus exertion made public as sound.

changed_reading.before: The comparison functions chiefly as a species-based insult to an ugly cry.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also warns against making the voice a public signal of strain and force, with the donkey cry as the literal carrier of that effect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cross-scale move from stabilized earth to human gait is reader-supplied and therefore surprising. It remains anchored in the focus's straight walking and the packet's paired stability-sway cues; render it as a material analogy, not as an asserted cosmological equivalence.

activation_trace.role: Firm settling supplies macroscopic stability; it offers a material image for holding a line under motion.
Movement, disturbance, and swaying supply the instability being prevented; they sharpen moderation as active balance.
Straight and even walking supplies the human-scale stable line to which the material analogy attaches.
Walking supplies motion rather than stillness; it makes stability dynamic and continuously corrected.

changed_reading.before: Moderation in gait means reduced pace or modest appearance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is dynamic stabilization: moving while continually preventing the self from swaying into excess.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The analogy between celestial or maritime courses and one person's walk is cross-domain, so it should remain qualified. It is still anchored by QṢD orientation, straight walking, repeated running, and an appointed limit; render it as a course-image that supplements, not replaces, social manners.

activation_trace.role: Continuous running and flow supply ordered motion; they enlarge walking from isolated steps into a sustained course.
An appointed temporal limit supplies boundedness; it makes a course answer to an end rather than mere momentum.
A ship's flowing course supplies directed motion through a resistant medium; it reinforces steadiness without stasis.
Orientation toward a thing supplies purpose; it anchors the larger course analogy in the imperative.
Straight and even walking supplies local course-keeping rather than unbounded movement.
Voluntary walking supplies the human movement that receives the cosmic and maritime analogy.

changed_reading.before: The command regulates the style and speed of individual steps.
changed_reading.after: It can also regulate life as bounded course-keeping: move intentionally, sustain a line, and let motion answer to an end.

strongest_changes: Lowering the voice became a refusal of coercive amplification: diverted speech and willful non-hearing show that volume cannot create uptake.
The NKR echo with recognized good and repudiated wrong made vocal delivery ethically part of corrective speech.
The cheek-gait-voice sequence reframed moderation as coordinated reduction of visible and audible self-expansion.
The later QṢD recurrence after waves and rescue activated moderation as recovery of course after crisis.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaved as a regulator of outward amplitude across trajectory and sound, while context activated recognizable correction, subtle efficacy, and post-crisis recovery without collapsing those readings into one.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether أَنكَرَ is primarily acoustic unpleasantness or can sustain recognition and moral-repudiation senses at equal weight.
Whether the 31:32 QṢD recurrence can bear the embodied recovery analogy or chiefly classifies a post-rescue stance.
Whether divine subtle knowledge and hearing directly support reduced human vocal force or only provide a thematic resonance.
How much weight the distant ḤMR severity branch can carry beyond the literal donkey comparison.
